english.notes:
(i) Section 92B of the Act was inserted by section 39 of the Asylum and Immigration (Treatment of Claimants, etc.) Act 2004.
(ii) Section 92B(2) provides that for the purpose of of this offence a person offers to provide advice or services if he:-
(a) makes an offer to a particular person or class of person,
(b) makes arrangements for an advertisement in which he offers to provide advice or services, or
(c) makes arrangements for an advertisement in which he is described or presented as competent to provide advice or services.

(iii) Section 92B(6) provides a time limit on prosecution as follows:-
an information relating to an offence under this section may in England and Wales be tried by a magistrates' court if-
(a) it is laid within the period of six months beginning with the date (or first date) on which the offence is alleged to have been committed, or
(b) it is laid:-
(i) within the period of two years beginning with that date, and (ii) within the period of six months beginning with a date certified by the Immigration Services Commissioner as the date on which the commission of the offence came to his notice.
